name: physmap
description: A desktop projection-mapping workspace with animated surfaces and 2D physics.

scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run icons && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run icons && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run icons && electron-builder --mac dmg --x64 --arm64
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run icons && electron-builder --win nsis --x64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run icons && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb --x64
